description: A PHP script responsible for generating and saving a vCard for contact information in the SuiteCRM project. It loads contact data and generates vCard files.

classes.name: vCard
classes.description: Class responsible for handling vCard creation, loading contact data, and saving vCards.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact information into the vCard instance using contact ID and module name.

methods.name: saveVCard
methods.description: Saves the constructed vCard to a file or output stream.
